# noozle_kafka_outlet (Data Source)

Reads a Noozle Kafka outlet by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "noozle_kafka_outlet" "example" {
  id = 123
}
```
